policy: Explicit legacy pending inventory for discovery-axis denominators. A task listed here publishes the discovery rates without the counts they are rates of, so the axis cannot be read: a correct_refusal_rate of 1.0 may be one world out of one or thirty out of thirty. Listing is never a pass and never an exemption from the requirement. Remove a task once its evaluator publishes a denominator or count beside each rate.
